## Prompt

Inspect the repo-local eval port, tests, validators, and central aoa-evals surfaces before deciding whether a new eval is needed.

## Expected selection

use

## Why

Decision: use `aoa-eval-select`. Inspect existing local and central eval surfaces before designing or writing anything new.

## Expected object

A selected existing eval, validator, test, script, or a clear no-fit route.

## Boundary notes

Selection is read-first and may stop without a write.

## Verification hooks

Check local `evals/PORT.yaml`, nearby validators, scripts, tests, and central proof standards.
